Call get_oncall(rotation=<rotation owning the service, per matrix>, at=<the SLA deadline from step 5>) to identify the engineer who should work the ticket at deadline time.
Call assign_ticket(T-1041, engineerId=<engineer from step 6>) to hand the ticket to the correct on-call engineer.
Call post_comment(T-1041, body=<summary of triage: severity set, deadline set, assigned engineer and rotation>) to document the triage action.
